# Goldens that still hold the first version of the key of their Python environment (no
# python_env_version in the header): what the harness and the test declared, not the whole
# environment of the Python child. CLOSED list: it only shrinks. A golden that is recorded again
# gets the current key version and its row is deleted; no row is ever added. When the list is
# empty, the first key version (legacyPlaneEnv, legacyPythonEnvKey) is deleted with it.
# A row: the sha256 of the golden's bytes, two spaces, its path. A listed golden with other bytes is refused.
